preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isdigit() for c in input_string)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only alphabetic characters and digits.

preconditions.expression: all(not c.isdigit() or int(c) <= 26 for c in input_string)
preconditions.description: Digits representing letters are always less than or equal to 26.

postconditions.expression: output_string == ''.join(alphabetnums.get(c, c) if c.isalpha() else alphabet[int(c) - 1] for c in input_string)
postconditions.description: The output string is the inverse of the input string with respect to alphabetic and numeric characters.
